_note: Enrichment target queue for the gated legal-corpus loop (see docs/research/corpus_enrichment_and_cot_training.md). The days/weeks agent loop picks a 'queued' target, researches it via WebSearch, drafts a candidate EvidenceClaim, runs the multi-prompt convergence + guardrail vet, and STAGES it for human review. Promotion into configs/duecare/legal_claims.json is a gated, append-only, human step. status: queued -> researching -> staged -> promoted (never auto-promoted).
